notes: CORE. Skidmore 2003 six-month placebo RCT, completer analysis (21 active, 19 placebo). One study month is represented as 30 days: months 2, 4, 6 become days 60, 120, 180. Only the active inflammatory-lesion series is fitted; placebo and aggregate comedones remain in sources.md. No graded skin-side-effect trajectory was reported, so simulated side-effect burden will be underestimated. This 20 mg BID evidence does not apply to 100 mg/day.

provenance.citation: Skidmore et al., Effects of Subantimicrobial-Dose Doxycycline in the Treatment of Moderate Acne, Arch Dermatol 2003;139:459–464, Table 2 and efficacy text; DOI 10.1001/archderm.139.4.459.
provenance.reported_figure: Active IL mean reduction: month 2 24%, month 4 36%; month 6 mean percent change −50.1%. Completer baseline 31.38 lesions; month-6 absolute change −15.71 lesions (SE 3.87), n=21.
provenance.derivation: Periostat hyclate 20 mg BID, Skidmore 2003: observed IL mean 31.38 -> B_ref 7.5 (D3). Mean reductions ×7.5 /1.508095 (D4). Month-6 change SE 3.87×sqrt(21)/15.71 -> CV 1.128871, sigma 0.906474; fixed-baseline scaling preserves CV. Month-2/4 spread absent. Step 5 fit residual pending.
